_comment: Sound effects to make with ElevenLabs (0.6.0, motionlab\sfxgen.py). Round 2 (the user, 2026-10-26: "clean premium motion graphics sfx, the sounds it created sound very generic and low quality"): each description says what the sound is FOR in a motion-graphics video, its material and attack, one-shot / dry / no music / no background, and what it must NOT be (cartoon, game, retro) - ElevenLabs' own guide: clear descriptions, sound terms (impact, whoosh, one-shot, glitch). WAV 48 kHz from the v3 model (the free key gets both); prompt_influence 0.6 = closer to the words; a length set = about 10 credits a second (measured: 41 credits for 4.1 s). Per kind: the descriptions used in turn, the length asked (seconds, 0.5 at least - the API's floor; the library cuts each to its sound), how many to make by default. The user, 2026-10-26, after listening to round 2: whooshes, whips, pops, keys and clicks kept, the rest "very cheap" -> those kinds make 0 by default (better descriptions first). "beds" (0.6.0 step 10, motionlab\music.py make_beds): ambience for under a talking video, made with ElevenLabs' loop (no seam) into library\music\ambience\<kind>\ - 15 s = about 150 credits each.
